items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mary Wright Edelman. She works with young people, kids. That’s one of my favorite people.

ctx.x: We talked earlier about vocalists who have influenced you. Now I would like to ask you if you have ever had, in your lifetime, any idols in any field, anybody that inspired you?
Dorothy Height, one of my favorite people. Mary Wright Edelman. She works with young people, kids. That’s one of my favorite people. Of course Martin – Martin
Luther King. Those are my – Dorothy Height was just phenomenal. I think she would be the person that I would say inspired me the most.
